body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Parrot introduced its new Bluetooth hands-free cell phone car kit with streaming audio.

It allows mp3 owners to listen to their favorite music in their cars hands-free cell phone car kit with streaming audio while enjoying the convenience of wireless cell phone capability via Bluetooth. It also presented its 7-inch Bluetooth photo frame; you can take a picture with a cell phone or a digital camera and make it appear immediately via Bluetooth. Parrot is a France-based Bluetooth specialist.
